Maya: FYI vendor scheduled NIC firmware push in eu-west2 2026-04-10 02:00-02:30 UTC. Expect staggered node reboots and short TCP resets.
Jun: Copy 1 0 What's blast radius? racks or whole pool?
Maya: Theyre doing rack-by-rack; estimated 8-12 racks affected (~25% pool).
Leo: Ops plan: cordon rack cohorts, drain noncritical work, pre-seed KV in eu-west1, tilt routing to eu-west1 for heavy sessions.
Jun: Quick commands (dry-run):
redwoodctl pool cordon --pool eu-west2 --cohort rack-A --dry-run
redwoodctl pool drain --pool eu-west2 --cohort rack-A --evacuate-tasks --grace-period 20s --dry-run
redwoodctl cache preseed --pool eu-west1 --prefix /kv/sessions --workers 6 --dry-run
infra-oncall: I'll watch error_rate and p99. Alert: error_rate(eu-west2) >4% for 3m -> page oncall; if >8% -> expand tilt.
ops-bot: Created MN-4950 and attached runbook.
Maya: Tenant comms: short status page blurb + targeted emails for pinned-region tenants.
Jun: I'll pause snapshot-upload and archive-sync jobs during window.
Maya: Dry-run at 01:30 UTC, live at 01:50 UTC. Keep channel for live updates. :thumbsup:
